turnos.mensaje: How long does standard shipping usually take?

Standard shipping usually takes 2 to 4 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. Free shipping applies to orders of $75 or more. Please note that Nerds Store does not currently ship internationally.
Okay, and does the $75 free shipping threshold apply before or after taxes?

The knowledge base states the free shipping threshold is $75, but it doesn't specify whether that amount is measured before or after taxes. For clarification, you can contact support at support@nerdsstore.example during business hours (Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM).

Got it, thanks. Would I still get free shipping if I use a discount code that brings my total under $75 after tax? Also, not related, but is the Raspberry Pi 5 I'm looking at compatible with the 2GB RAM version or only the

For the discount question, the knowledge base doesn't include information about discount codes or how they affect the free shipping threshold, so I can't confirm that. Please contact support@nerdsstore.example for clarification.

On the Raspberry Pi 5, that product isn't in the Nerds Store catalog as far as I can see, so I don't have compatibility details for it. Our catalog includes items such as the USB-C Hub H7 and the Laptop Stand S4, but no Raspberry Pi models.
Actually, changing the subject completely: does the Webcam C3 support 1080p and how does it connect?
Yes, the Webcam C3 supports 1080p video. It connects through USB-A.
Does the Webcam C3 come with a built-in microphone, and is there a cable length listed anywhere?

The knowledge base doesn't say whether the Webcam C3 has a built-in microphone, and it doesn't list a cable length. For those details, please contact support@nerdsstore.example during business hours (Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM).
Got it, thanks for the help. One last thing on the Webcam C3: does it work with both Windows and Mac, or is there anything I need to install?

The knowledge base doesn't include information about operating system compatibility or whether any software needs to be installed for the Webcam C3. Please contact support@nerdsstore.example during business hours (Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM) for those details.
